about: The pinyin and the gloss that one segment text shows in the example sentences (#479). An override applies to every segment with this text. Each override names a CC-CEDICT entry by its pinyin with tone numbers, and by trad when two entries have the same pinyin. The build stops when an override names no entry, or when a gloss has more than 3 senses. Add an override for an error that a person finds in use.

本.gloss: classifier for books, periodicals, files; root; origin

场.gloss: classifier for events, games, exams; large place; stage

款.gloss: classifier for versions or models (of a product); section; funds

下.gloss: down; below; (after a number) a time, once

把.gloss: (marks the object before the verb); to hold; classifier for things with a handle

被.gloss: (marks the passive) by; quilt; to cover

次.gloss: classifier for times or occurrences; next; second

张.gloss: classifier for flat objects, sheets; to open up; to spread

条.gloss: classifier for long thin things (river, road, trousers etc); strip; item

过.gloss: (after a verb) have done before; to cross; to pass (time)

回.gloss: to go back; to return; classifier for times or acts
